name: Snickers Full Size Candy Bar (Whole Peanuts WARNING)
whyItWorks: Contains dense clusters of whole roasted peanuts suspended in caramel and nougat. Whole peanuts do not dissolve and break into sharp, jagged fragments that can become trapped in narrowed bowel strictures.
prepOrOrderInstructions: STRICTLY AVOID if you have bowel strictures, active inflammation, or an ostomy. Choose smooth Reese's Peanut Butter Cups or plain milk chocolate instead.
